question: In which of the following years, was the founder of Sikhism, Sri Guru Nanak Dev, born? (RPF Constable 2024 (09/03/2025) Shift 2)
options: 1469
1576
1532
1425
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1469

Explanation:
Founder of Sikhism, Sri Guru Nanak Dev was born in 1469 CE at Talwandi (present-day Nankana Sahib, Pakistan). He was the first of the ten Sikh Gurus. He preached devotion to One God, equality, service, and truthfulness. His teachings are compiled in the Guru Granth Sahib. Guru Nanak Dev undertook four major journeys (Udasis) spreading his message across India, Tibet, Sri Lanka, and Mecca-Medina. He rejected caste system and idol worship.

☛ Followers of Guru Nanak → Sikhs

question: In which year was Radio broadcasting started in India by the Radio Club of Bombay? (RPF Constable 2024 (09/03/2025) Shift 3)

Explanation:

Later, the Indian Broadcasting Company (IBC) was established in 1927, which eventually became All India Radio (AIR) in 1936. The Radio Club of Bombay initiated regular broadcasts, laying the foundation for radio communication in the country. This event is considered a crucial step in the development of mass communication in India.

question:
In which of the following states is Gangaur festival celebrated by the women folk to
please Goddess Parvati? (RPF Constable 2024 (09/03/2025) Shift 3)
options: Uttarakhand
Jharkhand
Gujarat
Rajasthan
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Rajasthan

Explanation:
Gangaur is a major festival of Rajasthan where women worship Goddess Parvati (Gauri). It is celebrated on the third day of the bright half of the Chaitra month and continues for 18 days. Married women pray for the long life of their husbands, while unmarried girls seek a good spouse. The festival is associated with Lord Shiva and Parvati. It is celebrated with great enthusiasm across Rajasthan, especially in cities like Jaipur, Udaipur, Jodhpur, and Bikaner. Although it is also observed in some parts of Gujarat, the primary state for Gangaur is Rajasthan. Hence, the correct answer is Rajasthan.

☛ What do unmarried girls pray for during Gangaur? → Good husband

question: Which organization is primarily responsible for promoting free trade among nations? (RPF Constable 2024 (10/03/2025) Shift 1)
options: International Monetary Fund (IMF)
World Trade Organization (WTO)
United Nations (UN)
World Bank
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is World Trade Organization (WTO)

Explanation:
The World Trade Organization (WTO) is a global organization that regulates trade between nations and promotes free trade. Established in 1995 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, its primary objective is to reduce trade barriers and ensure fair competition. The WTO provides a forum for negotiating trade agreements and resolving disputes. In contrast, the IMF focuses on monetary stability and financial assistance, the World Bank provides loans for development projects, and the UN deals with international peace and security. Thus, the WTO is the key organization responsible for promoting free trade among nations.

☛ Where is the WTO headquarters located? → Geneva, Switzerland
☛ What was the predecessor of the WTO? → GATT (General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade)
☛ How many member countries are in the WTO? → 164 (as of 2023)
☛ Which was the latest ministerial conference held by the WTO? → MC13 in Abu Dhabi, 2024
question_hi: कौन-सा संगठन मुख्य रूप से राष्ट्रों के बीच मुक्त व्यापार को बढ़ावा देने के लिए जिम्मेदार है? (RPF Constable 2024 (10/03/2025) Shift 1)
options_hi: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मुद्रा कोष (IMF)
विश्व व्यापार संगठन (WTO)
संयुक्त राष्ट्र (UN)
विश्व बैंक
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है विश्व व्यापार संगठन (WTO)

Explanation:
विश्व व्यापार संगठन (WTO) एक वैश्विक संगठन है जो देशों के बीच व्यापार को नियंत्रित करता है और मुक्त व्यापार को बढ़ावा देता है। इसकी स्थापना 1995 में हुई थी और इसका मुख्यालय जिनेवा, स्विट्जरलैंड में है। WTO का मुख्य उद्देश्य व्यापार बाधाओं को कम करना और निष्पक्ष प्रतिस्पर्धा सुनिश्चित करना है। यह व्यापार विवादों के समाधान के लिए एक मंच प्रदान करता है और बहुपक्षीय व्यापार समझौतों की देखरेख करता है। IMF मुद्रा स्थिरता और वित्तीय सहायता पर केंद्रित है, जबकि विश्व बैंक विकास परियोजनाओं के लिए ऋण प्रदान करता है। UN अंतर्राष्ट्रीय शांति और सुरक्षा से संबंधित है। इस प्रकार, WTO मुक्त व्यापार को बढ़ावा देने का प्रमुख संगठन है।

question: According to Bharat Muni in Natya Shastra, Ghan Vadya is also (RPF Constable 2024 (10/03/2025) Shift 1)
options: string
wind
solid
percussion
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is solid

Explanation:
According to Bharat Muni's Natya Shastra, musical instruments are classified into four categories: tat (string), avanaddha (membrane), sushira (wind), and ghana (solid). Ghan Vadya refers to instruments made of solid materials that produce sound by striking or clashing, such as cymbals, manjira, and kartal. This classification is fundamental to Indian musicology. The other options correspond to different categories: string (tat), wind (sushira), and percussion (avanaddha), which are not correct for ghan vadya.

question: How many shrutis have been formulated for all practical purposes? (RPF Constable 2024 (10/03/2025) Shift 1)
options: 25
72
50
22
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 22

Explanation:
In Indian classical music, a Shruti refers to the microtonal intervals that divide an octave. Ancient texts mention 22 shrutis, which partition the seven basic notes (Sa, Re, Ga, Ma, Pa, Dha, Ni) into 22 distinct intervals. These shrutis are considered the practical foundation for musical performance. Although some texts refer to 66 or 84 shrutis, only 22 shrutis are used in practice. Each shruti has a specific name and interval, such as Tivra, Mandra, etc. This system is based on Bharata Muni's Natyashastra. The concept of shrutis is essential for understanding raga nuances and microtonal variations in Indian music.

question: As of October 2024, which of the following statements is correct regarding repo and reverse repo rates? (RPF Constable 2024 (10/03/2025) Shift 2)

question: Which of the following is NOT one of the four holy pilgrimage destinations where the Kumbh Mela is held by rotation? (RPF Constable 2024 (10/03/2025) Shift 2)
options: Haridwar
Varanasi
Nashik
Prayagraj
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Varanasi

Explanation:
The Kumbh Mela is held by rotation at four holy pilgrimage destinations: Prayagraj, Haridwar, Ujjain, and Nashik. It is the largest religious gathering in India, where millions of devotees take a holy dip in sacred rivers. Prayagraj has the confluence of Ganga, Yamuna, and Saraswati; Haridwar has the Ganga; Ujjain has the Shipra; and Nashik has the Godavari river. Varanasi (Kashi) is an extremely holy site but is not one of the four Kumbh Mela locations. The Kumbh Mela is held every 12 years at each location, while the Ardh Kumbh Mela is held every 6 years at Prayagraj and Haridwar.

question: Which of the following does NOT come in the Ghan Vadya category? (RPF Constable 2024 (10/03/2025) Shift 3)

question: How many shuddha notes were primarily there in Hindustani classical music? (RPF Constable 2024 (11/03/2025) Shift 1)
options: 3
7
11
6
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 7

Explanation:
In Hindustani classical music, there are primarily 7 shuddha (natural) notes, known as the saptak. These notes are: Sa, Re, Ga, Ma, Pa, Dha, Ni. Among these, Sa and Pa are always shuddha, while Re, Ga, Ma, Dha, Ni have two variants each (shuddha and vikrit). The number of shuddha notes is considered 7, although in extended form there are 12 swaras (7 shuddha + 5 vikrit). The concept of saptak originated from ancient Vedic times and forms the foundation of Indian music.

☛ Notes that are always shuddha → Sa and Pa

☛ Number of vikrit notes → 5 (komal Re, Ga, Dha, Ni and tivra Ma)
☛ Scale that uses all shuddha and vikrit notes → Thaat
